description: This Python source file defines the VertexAIFilesHandler class, responsible for managing file uploads and downloads to and from Google Cloud Storage (GCS) buckets in the context of Vertex AI and OpenAI File API integration. It includes methods for creating files asynchronously, extracting bucket and object information from file IDs, and handling file content retrieval both synchronously and asynchronously.

classes.description: A handler class for managing file operations with Vertex AI through GCS buckets, supporting asynchronous creation, content retrieval, and URI parsing.
